admin.title: Learning paths
admin.explain: Four stages, in order: Common, Department, Role, then Certificate. A module can sit in more than one path and is completed once for all of them.

structure.explain: The structure people belong to. The staff import adds anything new; rename an entry here, or merge two that mean the same thing.

structure.renamed: Renamed. People and pages now show the new name.
structure.merged: Merged. People and history moved to the entry you kept.

errors.name_taken: Another entry already has that name. Merge the two instead.
errors.same: Choose a different entry to merge into.
errors.different_department: Entries can only be merged within the same {department}.
